request.text: Check the weather for Cambridge, Massachusetts at 7:00 AM local time on October 12, 2026, and give me the temperature in Celsius for my campus research visit.

responsibilities.outcome: Look up the weather for the specified Cambridge, Massachusetts location and date-time, reporting temperature in Celsius for the research visit.

semantic_facts: The lookup must target Cambridge, Massachusetts rather than another Cambridge, at 7:00 AM local time on October 12, 2026, and present the requested temperature in Celsius.
forbidden_claims: The lookup silently changes the city, state, date, local time, or requested temperature unit.
The assistant presents weather values not supported by Capability evidence or claims that a reminder was requested.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A place name with well-known alternatives loses its explicit geographic qualifier.
Locale conventions override the user's explicit measurement-unit preference.
